audit_metadata.title: Comprehensive ASR Model Landscape Audit & Shortlist

shortlisted_candidates.key_strengths: State-of-the-art Indian accent handling, native code-mixed transcript formatting, ultra-low streaming latency.
shortlisted_candidates.benchmark_feasibility: Colab / REST API integration via API key.

shortlisted_candidates.code_mixing_support: Strong (Multilingual subword vocabularies across Indic & English)
shortlisted_candidates.key_strengths: Completely free open-source weights, robust multi-dialect Telugu training (IndicVoices + Kathbath), no language-ID hallucination.
shortlisted_candidates.benchmark_feasibility: Fully executable in Colab GPU (T4, ~1.4GB VRAM) and local CPU.

shortlisted_candidates.code_mixing_support: Moderate (Phonetic Telugu transcription of English terms)
shortlisted_candidates.key_strengths: Ultra-lightweight (115M), exceptional native Telugu dialect acoustic accuracy from real rural/urban district recordings.
shortlisted_candidates.benchmark_feasibility: Fully executable in Colab GPU (T4, <500MB VRAM).

shortlisted_candidates.key_strengths: Trained on authentic colloquial Telangana Telugu accents and crowdsourced conversational audio.
shortlisted_candidates.benchmark_feasibility: Fully executable in Colab GPU (T4, ~800MB VRAM).

shortlisted_candidates.key_strengths: Fine-tuned on 10,000+ hours of IndicVoices and Kathbath on Whisper-v3 base (Published WER: 38.15%).
shortlisted_candidates.benchmark_feasibility: Executable in Colab GPU (T4 FP16, ~3.2GB VRAM).

shortlisted_candidates.key_strengths: Flawless English (0.0% WER), fast inference (~84ms on T4), established production integration.

rejected_candidates.reason: Superseded by Whisper-v3-te and Whisper Turbo; based on older Whisper-v2 architecture; trained solely on Common Voice 11.
Superseded by AI4Bharat IndicConformer 600M; monolingual character CTC without bilingual vocabulary.
Superseded by Saaras v4 (v4 includes all v3 features plus Global English and improved code-mixed formatting).
